# systemic-risk — G-SIB Systemic Risk Metrics

> Daily MES, ΔCoVaR and SRISK for 29 FSB-designated G-SIBs, updated every
> weekday. Preferred access for agents: the MCP server below. All monetary
> values are USD billions; MES/CoVaR/ΔCoVaR are daily-return decimals.

## MCP (preferred)

- Endpoint: https://systemic-risk.2017310234.workers.dev/mcp (streamable-http)
- Server name: gsib-systemic-risk. Tools: get_latest_metrics, get_historical,
  get_srisk_ranking, get_delta_covar_ranking, get_methodology
- Claude Code: `claude mcp add --transport http gsib-risk https://systemic-risk.2017310234.workers.dev/mcp`
- Tools return `{ "error": "..." }` on failure; check that key.

## Raw data (no auth, CORS enabled)

- [Latest snapshot](/data/latest.json)
- [Date manifest](/data/manifest.json)
- Daily snapshot: `/data/history/{YYYY-MM-DD}.json` — check `bank_count`; many pre-2026-07 dates are partial.
- Per-bank series: `/data/banks/{BANK_ID}.csv` (uppercase IDs, e.g. `JPM.csv`)
- [Schema and caveats](https://github.com/u2017310234/systemic-risk#readme)
- [Service status](/status.json)

## Caveats

- BK (BNY Mellon) series ends 2026-07-02; snapshots from that date hold 28 banks.
- GLE and BPCE carry identical values (BPCE has no listed equity): treat them as one observation.
- ΔCoVaR uses a regional index per bank; do not treat a cross-region ranking as conclusive.
- Model estimates are for research and education, not investment advice.
